fact_check.claim: Aldi about $57 cheaper than Wegmans on a 50-item basket (Sept 2025 Northeast survey, no Ithaca stores)
fact_check.note: Aldi $255.94 vs Wegmans $312.91 = $56.97; stores in RI, NJ, NY (New Paltz, Warwick), none in Ithaca.

fact_check.claim: Survey priced 50 staples at 30 Northeast stores in late August and early September 2025
Basket totals: Aldi Johnston RI $255.94; Wegmans Montvale NJ $312.91; Tops New Paltz $336.54; Price Chopper Warwick NY $341.90
fact_check.note: All four figures match the source table.

fact_check.claim: Ranks: Aldi 1st, Wegmans 12th, Tops 18th, Price Chopper 21st of 30
Aldi beat the next-cheapest store by $15
fact_check.note: About $15 ahead of Walmart Neighborhood Market ($271.01).

fact_check.claim: Tops is a sister store to Price Chopper; many chains charge different prices at different locations
Aldi had many substitutions, more likely generic than name brand, smaller selection, so ranking is not like-for-like
fact_check.note: Post says Aldi's smaller selection meant more substitutions than most stores, often store brand. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Sun's 2022 list names two Aldi stores, a Wegmans, a Trader Joe's, a Tops, two GreenStar stores and Anabel's Grocery, no Price Chopper
Route 30 reaches Tops; Route 15 reaches Wegmans and Trader Joe's, once an hour on weekdays, fastest trip about half an hour (2022 snapshot)
fact_check.note: Matches, labeled as 2022 and dated. Half hour is per Google Maps in the source.

fact_check.claim: Katie Go '22, Anabel's employee: in Collegetown, nearby options cost more than Wegmans or Walmart, hard to reach without a car
fact_check.note: Source: food access hard without a car; GreenStar and 7-Eleven cost more than Wegmans or Walmart. Paraphrase is acceptable. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Alexandra Michael '23 and roommate went three weeks without grocery shopping, no car; unreliable transportation the biggest factor
Sun columnist Carlin Reyen (2024) calls Tops and P&C Fresh among the most affordable options; trip without a car a logistical nightmare; stranded in Lansing during a TCAT shortage
Ithaca Wegmans at 500 South Meadow Street, open 6 AM to midnight seven days a week
Cornell Health: try different stores in the Ithaca area for best prices; buy generic or store brands
Anabel's Grocery in Anabel Taylor Hall is student-run, discounted groceries, accepts SNAP, runs during the academic year
TCAT current fare, Route 15 current timetable, and Aldi Ithaca address/route not confirmed (article says so)
fact_check.note: tcatbus.com returned HTTP 403 for me too; Aldi locator redirects to a JS app that did not give addresses. The article states honestly it could not confirm these and gives no unsourced figures, and the 2022 frequency is labeled with its date. A web search listed Aldi on Third Street, but I did not use it as a source.
